downloadName.description: Name the browser saves the file as.

$schema.description: Editor helper that powers hints and error checking. Leave it as it is.

file.description: PDF path inside /public (or a media-library /media/… path), or null while the real PDF is not ready.

downloadName.description: Name the browser saves the file as, e.g. "Pradosh_Kumar_Lenka_Resume_Research.pdf".

description.description: One line describing this version (leave out until the real PDF exists).

items.description: One role-specific résumé in the Résumé Library selector.

variants.description: Role-specific versions shown as a selector (optional). Leave out to show only the Master Résumé above. Versions whose file is null are listed as "awaiting the PDF".

missing.description: Shown if the PDF file is missing.

choose.description: Selector heading, e.g. "Choose the résumé for your role".

awaiting.description: Shown for a version whose PDF is not ready yet. "{role}" is replaced.

useMaster.description: Button that switches to the Master Résumé from an awaiting version.

labels.description: Words used in the Résumé Library.
